scope: Near Me MASTERLOCK batch 4: resolve Ridgeback Center canonical identity between old and new Thanh Nga facilities.

accepted.rationale: Phu Quoc government tourism and Vietnam tourism sources identify the canonical destination at Tiểu khu 77; Vietnam tourism places Tiểu khu 77 in ấp Suối Mây. The secondary directory publishes a coordinate for the same Tiểu khu 77 named facility. Publish only as area_anchor, not entrance/site centroid.

rejected_or_hold.reason: Historical Google Maps reference corresponds to the older Thanh Nga facility lineage around Cây Thông Ngoài/Cửa Dương. Current canonical Tiểu khu 77 destination is the newer Suối Mây facility. Do not overwrite canonical with the old-facility pin.

masterlock: Identity disambiguation must precede coordinate promotion.
A secondary directory coordinate is not enough for exact entrance precision.
Use area_anchor when government sources establish the destination area but entrance is not verified.
No live opening status inferred from map/location evidence.
